pll2d6c2-d1e3514.summary: States that for such pride Lucifer was cast from the empyrean into this dark air with all his accomplices; as Revelation says, the dragon falling drew a third of the stars, since many fell with him who consented to his malice. This was done for our testing and exercise.
claims: Lucifer fell with many consenting angels into the air.

pll2d6c2-d1e3546.summary: Cites Eph 6:12: our struggle is against spiritual wickedness in the heavens, since demons dwell in the turbulent air near us, called heaven; hence the devil is called prince of the air.
claims: Demons dwell in the air near us.
The devil is prince of the air.

pl-l2d6c2.summary: States that for such pride Lucifer was cast from the empyrean into this dark air with all his accomplices; the dragon drew a third of the stars (Rev 12:4). This was for our testing and exercise: we wrestle against spiritual wickedness in the heavens (Eph 6:12), since demons dwell in this turbulent air near us, called 'heaven,' and the devil is called prince of the air.
claims: Lucifer was cast from the empyrean into the dark air.
Many angels who consented to his malice fell with him.
Their dwelling in the air serves for our testing and exercise.
Demons dwell in the turbulent air near us.
